description: This PHP class 'SaveCustomerController' is a controller within the OrangeHRM Time Plugin, responsible for rendering the customer save/edit component depending on the presence of an ID attribute in the HTTP request. It extends an abstract Vue controller and manages VueJS components and properties for customer data.

classes.name: SaveCustomerController
classes.description: Controller for handling customer save/edit pages, dynamically setting Vue components based on request data.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering, choosing between 'customer-edit' and 'customer-save' based on whether an ID is present in the request.
